facts.text: Mother says stay in, so I'm cooking. The lanterns go up after dessert, and the frying pan is for the eggs this time.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as if Rapunzel says it, but it is not a line from the film. It reads as a written note and fits the plot, so store it as a note, not a quote.
facts.fix: Mother says stay in, so I'm cooking. The lanterns go up after dessert, and the frying pan is for the eggs this time.

facts.text: Serve the mains when Mother Gothel promises to make hazelnut soup.
facts.why: Neither the plot nor the quote page mentions hazelnut soup. They show Gothel refusing Rapunzel's request to see the lanterns.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Rapunzel asks Mother Gothel to see the lanterns.
